name: hotel-concierge
description: Domain-specific Kiro Power for the Hotel Management App. Provides specialised skills for guest request handling, dietary filtering, concierge inquiries, kitchen order dispatching, and staff priority queue management.

skills.name: Guest Request Handler
skills.description: Handles guest food orders, dietary filtering, service requests, and concierge inquiries within the hotel domain model.

skills.name: Staff Order Dispatch
skills.description: Manages kitchen order dispatching, real-time KDS queue management, and staff priority assignment for order fulfillment.

hotel_name.description: The display name of the hotel property

default_service_charge_rate.description: Default service charge rate applied to food orders (0–0.20)

max_dietary_filters.description: Maximum number of dietary filters a guest can apply simultaneously

kitchen_dispatch_priority_window_minutes.description: Time window (minutes) within which orders are considered equal priority for batch dispatch
